messages.work-brief.empty.title: This project has no brief yet
messages.work-brief.error.no-answer: No response came back. Check your connection and try again.
messages.work-brief.fixed.toast: Fixed and saved to the library
messages.work-brief.help.advanced: Shows one project inside a project workspace and cross-project highlights in personal view; works without a text model connected.
messages.work-brief.help.example-1: Open project home to scan today’s updates and decisions waiting for you
messages.work-brief.help.example-2: Click any card to jump straight into the owning plugin
messages.work-brief.help.scope: Reads summaries from existing plugins without copying or altering their data; disabling it falls back cleanly to the basic project home with all data intact.
messages.work-brief.help.title: Work Brief
messages.work-brief.help.what: Brings together recent project changes, items waiting on you, and clear next steps so you can pick up right where you left off.
messages.work-brief.mode.label: Scope
messages.work-brief.next.none: This version has no next steps.

messages.work-brief.next.stale-note: What it acts on has changed, so it won’t run. The next brief prepares it again for the new state.

messages.work-brief.next.unknown-note: This run didn’t confirm a result — it may or may not have taken effect. Check where it acts first, then clear this record before running it again.
messages.work-brief.next.unknown-toast: Result not confirmed. Check where it acts.

forms.other: The new draft differs from your edits in {count} places

messages.work-brief.version.label: Version {version}
messages.work-brief.version.none: No other versions yet. The next change creates a new one while this stays unchanged.
messages.work-brief.permission.work-brief-read.re: Read briefs, versions, and source citations
messages.work-brief.permission.work-brief-write.r: Save, refresh, edit, and pin briefs
messages.work-brief.permission.storage-private.re: Save brief content, versions, your edits, and next-step choices
messages.work-brief.permission.actions-delegate.r: Read source summaries and citations with your access, and run a next step when you click it
messages.work-brief.permission.artifact-write.rea: Save pinned brief versions as artifacts
messages.work-brief.permission.artifact-read.reas: Verify artifacts linked to pinned brief versions
messages.work-brief.permission.projects-reach.rea: Roll up items needing your attention across projects in your personal brief; when off, only personal items appear
messages.work-brief.read-group.work-brief.title: Work Brief
messages.work-brief.read-group.work-brief.descrip: Project briefs, their versions, and source citations
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-list.title: List briefs
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-list.descripti: Lists briefs and current version numbers in this project, with the main project brief first followed by topic briefs.
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-get.title: Read brief
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-get.descriptio: Reads a brief version (defaulting to the active main brief), including source status, citations, items needing attention, next steps, and optional version comparison.
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-save.title: Save brief
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-save.descripti: Saves a cited draft as a new brief version or topic brief, checking citations and next steps first. Conflicts with your manual edits are saved as a proposal for review.
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-refresh.title: Refresh brief
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-refresh.descri: Re-reads sources and citations with your access without calling a model. Creates a new version only when something changed, keeping your edits and pinned versions intact.
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-edit.title: Edit a brief sentence
messages.work-brief.actions.briefs-edit.descripti: Edits, removes, or adds a sentence in the active brief and saves it as a manual edit so later drafts won’t overwrite it. Pinned versions can’t be edited.
messages.work-brief.actions.proposals-resolve.des: Chooses your wording or the draft’s for each conflicting sentence, or discards the proposal. Resolving every conflict saves a new brief version.
messages.work-brief.actions.versions-fix.title: Pin brief version
messages.work-brief.actions.versions-fix.descript: Pins a brief version and saves it as a read-only artifact for keeping, citing, or sharing. Pinning again returns the same artifact.
messages.work-brief.actions.next-run.title: Run brief next step
messages.work-brief.actions.next-run.description: Runs a prepared next step as you and records the result. Refuses to run if the target changed or the action is unavailable; each step runs only once.
messages.work-brief.actions.next-set.title: Mark brief next step
messages.work-brief.actions.next-set.description: Marks a next step as later, handed to the assistant, or clears the mark. Only updates its status in the brief without changing other records.
messages.work-brief.actions.presentation-values.d: Reads display fields for the requested briefs within your current access, marking unavailable or deleted items without modifying data.
messages.work-brief.actions.presentation-overview: Reads a brief overview, opening lines, and quick entry points. Read-only and doesn’t call a model.
messages.work-brief.actions.search-entries.title: List searchable briefs
messages.work-brief.actions.search-entries.descri: Lists project briefs in batches for search indexing. Read-only and doesn’t modify data.
messages.work-brief.actions.subject-read.title: Read brief content and links
messages.work-brief.actions.subject-read.descript: Reads a brief’s current content, version, and cited links for accurate reference.
messages.work-brief.actions.artifacts-preview.des: Renders a brief version as a readable document for artifact preview, side panels, or workflows without modifying data.
messages.work-brief.actions.personal-get.title: Read personal brief
messages.work-brief.actions.personal-get.descript: Summarizes pending items from project briefs you can access alongside saved personal items. Read-only and doesn’t re-read sources.
messages.work-brief.actions.personal-refresh.desc: Re-reads personal sources as you without calling a model. Saves a new version only when something changed, marking unreadable sources as stale or missing.
